name: Checkout requires payment proof before completion
description: Verify checkout cannot reach Ringkasan without a valid payment-proof upload and transfer confirmation, then completes after the backend accepts the proof.

planSteps.description: Clear cookies and local storage. Open the store, add exactly one Classic Ceramic Mug to the cart, sign in as rafi.ahmad@example.com with password RafStore#2026, and open /checkout.

Fill shipping with recipient TestSprite Mandatory Proof 2026-07-17, phone 081234567890, address Jalan TestSprite Mandatory Proof Nomor 17 Jakarta, city Jakarta, province DKI Jakarta, postal code 12345, then continue to Pembayaran and continue to Konfirmasi.
On checkout step 3 Konfirmasi, verify Bukti pembayaran is marked Wajib, the text says it is required to complete checkout, and there is no general Lanjutkan button that can bypass the upload.
Verify the Unggah bukti & selesaikan checkout button is disabled before a file is selected and the Ringkasan step cannot be opened.
Generate and select a valid small PNG payment-proof file but leave the transfer confirmation checkbox unchecked.
Verify the upload-and-complete button remains disabled and the page remains on Konfirmasi while transfer confirmation is unchecked.
Check the transfer confirmation checkbox, press Unggah bukti & selesaikan checkout, and wait for the upload response.
Verify the checkout advances to Ringkasan only after upload succeeds, displays a real RAF order number, and shows payment status Menunggu verifikasi.
